pg_password.description: PostgreSQL password of the dev map store's owner role mapstudio (Docker secret, generated by ops/lib.sh into the git-ignored ops/secrets/)

map_token.description: The dev map's basemap token (Docker secret, generated by ops/gen_secrets.py into the git-ignored ops/secrets/ as a placeholder that is not a real token; replace its content with a public pk. Mapbox token to see real satellite tiles, never commit one)
